def solve():

    abbreviations = [sys.stdin.readline().strip() for _ in range(n)]
    used = set()

    for abbr in abbreviations:
        y = abbr.split("IAO'")[1]
        y_len = len(y)
        found = False
        year = 1989
        while True:
            last_digits = str(year)[-y_len:]
            candidate_abbr = f"IAO'{last_digits}"
            if candidate_abbr not in used and last_digits == y:
                used.add(candidate_abbr)
                print(year)
                found = True
                break
            year += 1

solve()
